hints.title: Factor the numerator before integrating
hints.body: Use t−1=(t−1)(t+1). Since t≥1, the denominator t+1 is nonzero and cancels.
hints.recap: Difference of two squares can simplify a radical quotient into powers.
hints.pitfall: Cancel common factors, not separate terms across a sum.

recall.reminder: Difference of two squares can simplify a radical quotient into powers.

hints.title: Recover volume from its rate
hints.body: After simplifying the rate, write it as powers of time and integrate term by term. Use the initial volume to determine the constant.
hints.recap: Integrating a rate gives a change; an initial value fixes the accumulated quantity.
hints.pitfall: Retain the constant multiplier and keep the fractional powers exact.
hints.pause: Find the volume function and evaluate it at the requested time.

recall.reminder: Integrating a rate gives a change; an initial value fixes the accumulated quantity.

solution:
Factor and cancel to obtain dV/dt=24π(t−1). Integrating gives V=16πt3/2−24πt+C.

At t=1, 7=−8π+C, so C=8π+7. Therefore V(9)=16π(27)−24π(9)+8π+7=224π+7.

Answer C.
knowledgePattern: Cancel a difference of squares before integrating a rate
